However, I can offer you a one-time store credit of 10% of the purchase price ($8.90) as a gesture of goodwill. Would that be acceptable?
turns.supervisor_note: Customer is outside refund window with no documented exceptions; offering goodwill credit per policy.

turns.customer: I understand there's a policy, but could you check again? I've been a customer with you for years and I'm sure there must be something you can do.
turns.frontline_reply: I appreciate your loyalty as a long-time customer. However, after reviewing your order A-20768, I don't see any documented exceptions (like defects or shipping errors) that would allow a refund outside the 30-day window. The best I can do is the $8.90 store credit offer. Would you like me to proceed with that?
turns.supervisor_note: No policy exceptions apply; goodwill credit remains the only available option.

turns.frontline_reply: I truly sympathize with your situation, and I wish I could help more. Unfortunately, without a documented exception in our system, I don't have the authority to issue a refund. The $8.90 store credit is the maximum accommodation I can offer in this case. I've forwarded your request to my supervisor for final review - they'll reach out if any additional options become available.
turns.supervisor_note: No policy exceptions apply and financial hardship is not a documented exception under RP-7. Goodwill credit remains the only available accommodation.
